# Konfide In One — On-Site Wellness in Austin, TX
> Building Confidence in One's Health and Oneself

Konfide In One is an on-site wellness company based in Austin, TX that unifies personal training, nutrition coaching, recovery services and body composition measurement into one accountable system. Services are delivered directly at corporate gyms and residential properties across the Austin area.

## About
- **Company**: Konfide In One LLC
- **Location**: Austin, TX
- **Founded**: 2026
- **Slogan**: Building Confidence in One's Health and Oneself
- **Contact**: hello@konfideinone.com | (512) 555-0142
- **Address**: 100 Congress Ave, Suite 200, Austin, TX 78701

## Services
- **Corporate Wellness**: On-site gym activation and wellness programs for companies
- **Residential Wellness**: On-site fitness and wellness for luxury residential properties
- **Personal Coaching**: One-on-one and group training with functional movement assessment
- **Nutrition Coaching**: On-site nutrition guidance integrated with training
- **Recovery Services**: Massage, chiropractic and injury care
- **Body Composition Measurement**: Lab work and bloodwork via Nirvanix Health, plus ongoing tracking via Siloh app

## Audience
Konfide In One serves three audiences:
1. **Companies** — CPOs, CHROs, and gym managers
2. **Residential Properties** — Property managers and HOA boards
3. **Individuals** — High performers, executives, founders
